metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: This ensemble workplace comedy shares the same optimistic and heartwarming energy as Ted Lasso and the high-concept humor of Community.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A wholesome yet quirky family animation that captures the grounded, character-driven charm of King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A quintessential British sitcom with geek-centric humor that aligns perfectly with Silicon Valley and Peep Show.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A hilarious mockumentary about vampires that provides the same dry, supernatural humor seen in The Good Place and Dirk Gently.
